description.en: Rhacophyton ceratangium sterile whole-habit educational reconstruction. Andrews and Phillips primary abstract supports bipinnate non-laminate fronds and woody axes. A published secondary historical reconstruction depicts spiral fronds; other literature describes paired rows, so whole-habit/spiral arrangement is explicitly interpretive. Nominal size, green palette and module counts are art choices, not replicated specimen measurements.
description.zh: Rhacophyton 枝系的历史解释性重建，采用开放分叉细轴而非现代宽叶；整株习性与叶序仍不确定，螺旋叶序不是科学定论。 尺寸、配色与简化具有示意性；原始简报、来源和独立审查中的限制仍适用。

scientific_scope.en: Rhacophyton ceratangium sterile whole-habit educational reconstruction. Andrews and Phillips primary abstract supports bipinnate non-laminate fronds and woody axes. A published secondary historical reconstruction depicts spiral fronds; other literature describes paired rows, so whole-habit/spiral arrangement is explicitly interpretive. Nominal size, green palette and module counts are art choices, not replicated specimen measurements. File-space dimensions are exported geometry bounds, not real-world specimen/locality measurements. Catalogue category is navigation only, not a claim of settled biological affinity.
